{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
df_control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute response fraction
n_total = len(df_control_moderate)
n_responded = df_control_moderate['responded'].sum()
response_fraction = n_responded / n_total

# Print the response_fraction as a float with sufficient precision to capture the exact value
print(response_fraction)"}
